name_input: STELLANTIS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; Stellantis India Private Limited; Stellantis India Private Limited; FCA INDIA AUTOMOBILES PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey (India customs), STELLANTIS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED: "2026-02-28 | STELLANTIS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | PCA SLOVAKIA SRO | REAR DOOR INNER WAIST SEAL LH -PARTNO:9852826380- | IRUNGATTUKOTTAI ICD INILP6, India | Hamburg, GERMANY | 87089900 | 1123326" — origin port in India, destination Hamburg/Germany, B/L 1123326. Second record set, FCA INDIA AUTOMOBILES PRIVATE LIMITED: "2025-01-21 | FCA INDIA AUTOMOBILES PRIVATE LIMITED | PEUGEOT CITROEN DO BRAZIL AUTOMOVEI | HEATER CORE PART NO - 9866216280 | IRUNGATTUKOTTAI ICD INILP6, India | Santos, Brazil | 87089100 | 7461347". Source counter: ImportKey header states "Total Shipments 71735" for Stellantis India and "Total Shipments 51577" for FCA India; rows actually visible on the free page: 5 + 5 = 10 shipment lines (free view truncates). Destinations seen: Germany (Hamburg), Brazil (Santos); counterparties listed include PCA Slovakia, Peugeot Citroen do Brasil, Stellantis Japan, PT National Assemblers (Indonesia), Stellantis Europe S.p.A.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with HS codes and destination ports — not merely website claims. Note the declared HS 870850 (drive axles/parts) does not match the observed lines, which are 87089900, 87082900, 87089100 (body/heat-exchange parts); per project rule this is not a rejection ground — actual HS should be recorded as 87089900/87082900/87089100 and verdict treated as accepted_hs_corrected. Domestic supply evidence could not be verified: volza.com, thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com all returned HTTP 403 to the fetch tool, and DuckDuckGo search was unavailable (connection refused) during this run, so GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders and annual-report India sales splits are null — not public to this tool set, not invented. Revenue and export volume figures: null (ImportKey free view gives shipment counts only, no values). Entity note: 'Stellantis India Private Limited' and 'FCA India Automobiles Private Limited' appear in the same customs counterparty lists and share the same registered address (Beneffice, 2nd Floor, Mathuradas Mill Compound, Tulsi Pipe Road, Mumbai), consistent with a group/renamed-entity relationship; both are live in customs data through 2025-01-21 and 2026-02-28 respectively, so neither is liquidated or struck off on this evidence. No sanctions/court findings were researched (out of scope and not a rejection ground).
